doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Working and recording with Jelly Roll Morton
summary: Ory recorded with Jelly Roll in Chicago only, and notes New Orleans had no recording at the time.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Remembering Jelly Roll Morton: the man, the band

blocks.x: Did you ever play with Jelly Roll out here on the coast in California? No. Did you ever work with Jelly?
No. I only recorded with Jelly in Chicago.
Did you ever play any other dates with Jelly or just the records?
Just records. Just the records. Jelly never had a band. In Chicago he'd go around all the clubs and pick the men he wanted for recording. Yeah. Any records. Any records.
Didn't they have any recording facilities at all in New Orleans? No. And then at that time no one in New Orleans was recording? No.
